feeStructurePatch.Additional Notes - Typical Application F: $500/guest room, minimum $100,000. Partial refund if application withdrawn before approval (less $15,000). Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote. Illustrative 200-room total investment about $325,352–$457,585/key excluding land.
feeStructurePatch.Additional Notes - Typical Royalty Fee R: 6% on gross room revenue plus 1% on gross food and beverage sales. Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.
feeStructurePatch.Additional Notes - Typical Marketing Fee: Services contribution 3% of gross room revenue in aggregate (marketing and reservations-related fees). Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.
feeStructurePatch.Additional Notes - Typical Loyalty Progr: IHG One Rewards assessments: 4.55% qualifying full-folio revenue and 1.365% qualifying room and meeting revenue. Model net after chargebacks. Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.
feeStructurePatch.Additional Notes - Typical Tech: Technology services fee about $17.06/room/month plus other mandatory IHG systems (PMS, CRS, digital, Wi‑Fi). Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.
feeStructurePatch.Additional Notes - Typical Reservation /: GDS fee about $6.40/reservation; IHG Ignite digital marketing commission about 2.25% on qualifying consumed revenue. Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.
feeStructurePatch.Additional Notes - Typical Training Fee: Pre-opening support about $20,000–$35,000; department-head certification about $40,000–$60,000; IHG Learning Program about $5,500/year. Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.
feeStructurePatch.Typical Incentives Offered: Key money, fee ramps, and conversion co-investment may be available in competitive gateway markets—deal-specific.
feeStructurePatch.Typical Termination Fee Structure (if an: Termination with cause may trigger liquidated damages—review cure periods and exit framework with counsel.
feeStructurePatch.Typical Expectations for Owner-Funded Re: FF&E, capital reserve (up to 5% of gross revenue may apply), and public-space reserves typical for upper-upscale lifestyle conversions.

dealTermsPatch.Renewal Structure: No automatic renewal — re-licensing may be offered
dealTermsPatch.Typical Renewal Conditions: Initial license term is 20 years for new development and 10 years for conversions; change-of-ownership/re-licensing typically 10 years. License does not provide automatic renewal—re-licensing may carry materially different terms. Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.
dealTermsPatch.Typical Cure Period for Performance Test: Cure periods apply to QA, fee, and reporting defaults—confirm with counsel.
